name: Joshua Clifford
original_name: ジョシュア・クリフォード
source:
[i]"What an awful situation. My condolences."[/i]

A 4th year student and one of Michael's roommates. He doesn't talk much. He's an indoor type who loves to read. Prefers to be the referee during football matches since he's not good at sports. He's best friends with Robert, who's an outdoorsy type.

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
